story_overview: In the main workshop, Richard introduces a new cylindrical assembly tool to his colleagues Gus, Ethan, and Simon. Led by Marcus, the team uses the tool in various demonstrations. The focus then shifts to a gardening project where they place a potted palm into a large round planter, while Gus and Chloe are seen shopping for more planters at a garden center.
